module: Pursuit mode manager: a gameplay event where several "chase" vehicles (police) pursue several "flee" vehicles (fugitives), players or AI. Only one instance at a time. It inserts the vehicles (police/suspect roles), handles the goals (free, timed, score, destination modes), the start (manual or at a given speed), arrests, recovery of released fugitives and stuck detection. The manager states are 'off', 'ready', 'active', 'inactive' and 'complete'.
usage:
local p = gameplay_pursuit_pursuit
p.setupPursuit(policeId, suspectId, {gameMode = 'timed', timeLimit = 120, recoveryMode = 'basic'})
p.start()
notes: Options read: gameMode, timeLimit, scoreGoal, arrestGoal, locationGoal, startSpeed (auto start when a fugitive reaches this speed, m/s), recoveryMode ('none', 'basic', 'teleportRoad', 'teleportStart', 'teleportRandom', otherwise fade only), autoRecovery, shuffleVehGroups, shuffleSpots, zoneName.
Goal constraints (setupGoals): timed mode -> time >= 30 s and arrestGoal = number of fugitives if <= 0; score mode -> score >= 100; destination mode -> locations >= 1.
Winners passed to stop(winner) and to the onPursuitGameplayFinished hook: 'flee' or 'chase'; time elapsed in timed mode = fugitives win, otherwise the pursuers; 'none' if all vehicles are stuck.
A 10 s grace period (defaults.graceTime) prevents arrests and stuck detection at the start; all vehicles under 2.5 m/s for 10 consecutive seconds are considered stuck.
Emitted hooks: onPursuitGameplayStarted, onPursuitGameplayFinished({winningTeam}), onPursuitGameplayEvent('recoverAll'|'stuckAll'), onPursuitAction (for fugitives).
Probable bug in onPursuitAction (arrest): the loop over chaseVehs reuses the name vehId for its variable, so `vehData.role.targetId == vehId` compares to the pursuer's own id, not the arrested one's.

Probable bug in onPursuitAction (evade): the next-target test uses `targetVeh.pursuitUsable` (already set to false) instead of vehData.pursuitUsable: nextTargetId stays nil and the pursuers are simply reset.

Probable bug in setupVehiclesFromFiles: parkingSpots is redeclared as `local` inside the if block, the outer variable stays nil: the start points from the sites files are never used (automatic 'roadAhead' placement).
When a vehicle is already in traffic, its data is shared (isShared); it has ignorePursuit = true so the main police system ignores it.
reset() is called on module load and also resets the gameplay_police pursuit variables.

reset.desc: Completely resets the manager (stops the gameplay if running, clears the vehicles, sets the state to 'off', resets the vehicles and the gameplay_police variables).

restart.desc: Sets the gameplay back to the 'ready' state without clearing the manager: resets the data, the pursuits and returns the vehicles to their original position (interactRecovery loadHome). Does not start.

start.desc: Starts the gameplay ('ready' or 'inactive' states only): activates the vehicles (pursuers in pursuitStart action level 3, fugitives in fleePolice) and emits onPursuitGameplayStarted.

stop.desc: Stops the active gameplay. With a winner, the state becomes 'complete', the fugitives' pursuits are reset and onPursuitGameplayFinished is emitted; without a winner, the state becomes 'inactive'.

winner.desc: 'flee', 'chase' or another non-nil value to finish; nil to simply pause.

insertVeh.desc: Validates and inserts a vehicle into the manager. Reuses the traffic data if there is any (isShared), otherwise creates a traffic vehicle object. Gives it the police or suspect role, disables respawn and pooling, and sets the AI to 'stop' mode (or 'disabled' for a player).

isAiControlled.desc: true if driven by the AI (not usable by the player).

returns.desc: true if inserted, false if the data could not be created, nil if id is missing or already inserted.

removeVeh.desc: Removes a vehicle from the manager and gives it back its automatic traffic role if it is part of it.

setupGoals.desc: Computes the goals (mode, time, score, arrests, locations) from the options; applies minimums depending on the mode.

options.desc: gameMode, timeLimit, scoreGoal, arrestGoal, locationGoal; default manager.options.

setupPursuit.desc: Creates a pursuit with one existing pursuer and one existing fugitive (first resets the manager if it is not 'off'). Moves to the 'ready' state.

returns.desc: false if one of the vehicles is not found.

setupPursuitMulti.desc: Creates a pursuit with several pursuers and fugitives. Fails (reset) if there is no pursuer or no fugitive inserted; warns if some failed.

returns.desc: true if the setup is ready.

setupVehicles.desc: Spawns the vehicle groups (core_multiSpawn.spawnGroup, names 'autoPursuitChase' and 'autoPursuitFlee') then, via onVehicleGroupSpawned, calls setupPursuitMulti. Uses the provided parking points, otherwise places the vehicles on the road ahead (15 m gap).

chaseVehGroup.desc: Vehicle group {model, config...} of the pursuers.

parkingSpots.desc: Points {pos, rot}, the first ones for the pursuers.

returns.desc: false if a quantity is less than 1.

setupVehiclesFromFiles.desc: Like setupVehicles but reads the vehicle groups (data field) from JSON files, and optionally the parking points from a sites file (optional zone options.zoneName, shuffle options.shuffleSpots, filter by chase/flee tags).

chaseVehGroupFile.desc: Path of the pursuer group JSON.

fleeVehGroupFile.desc: Path of the fugitive group JSON.

returns.desc: false if the quantities are invalid or a group file is unreadable.

filterParkingSpots.desc: Copies the parking point list and, if both quantities are given, rearranges it into n points tagged 'chase' then n points tagged 'flee' (without the opposite tag). Keeps the original list if the two lists are not filled enough.

getManager.desc: Returns the manager object (vehData, vehIds, chaseVehs, fleeVehs, options, goals, state, running, data{duration, arrests, totalScore, tempScore, locations, roadblocks}).

onPursuitAction.desc: Hook emitted by gameplay_police for a pursuit action. Active only if the state is 'active' and for a fugitive: 'arrest' counts the arrest, 'evade' removes the fugitive from targeting, 'release' applies the recoveryMode.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame. Updates the non-shared vehicles, triggers the automatic start (options.startSpeed), and in active play: duration, targeting every second, stuck detection, recovery, fades, total score and victory conditions.

onVehicleGroupSpawned.desc: core_multiSpawn hook: when the 'autoPursuitChase' then 'autoPursuitFlee' groups have spawned, calls setupPursuitMulti with the stored data; fails (reset) if one of the groups is empty.

onTrafficStarted.desc: Hook at traffic start: replaces the traffic entries with the manager's data for the vehicles that are part of it.

onTrafficStopped.desc: Hook at traffic stop; does nothing.

onTrafficAmountChanged.desc: Hook on change of the number of traffic vehicles; does nothing.

onSerialize.desc: Hook before Lua reload: returns the manager state (options, goals, data, state) and the serialized vehicle data.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook after Lua reload: resets then restores the manager and reinserts the vehicles.
